## Calendar Check

- [ ] Check my calendar for conflicts
- [ ] Check attendee calendars for conflicts (is this possible for a recurring meeting?)
- [ ] Check calendar to see if there are any holidays
- [ ] Reschedule meeting if necessary
- [ ] Set a reminder on this page using the line below for the Monday before the meeting
	- Product Development Lifecycle meeting is this Friday

## Prep Tasks

- [ ] Create a new document in SharePoint for this month’s meeting
	- [ ] Update the dates in the document
		- [ ] First page header
		- [ ] First page table
		- [ ] Subsequent page headers
- [ ] Update meeting document with latest developments on existing pilots. Possible sources:
	- Notion items, SPRs, emails
- [ ] Update meeting document with explicit lifecycle stage changes (Pilot Planning/Pilot Release/Limited Release/General Release)
- [ ] Add any new pilot projects to the meeting document
- [ ] Read through previous notes in meeting document and see if any projects are ready to be moved to a different release status. Add a note for any that have changed
- [ ] Update the RM Pilot board with any new items/tasks or changes in status
- [ ] Update the Agenda section with any items that I think should be discussed
	- [ ] Make sure that each Agenda item has either an updated note or an entry on this page’s *Meeting Agenda Topics* section with some sort of description
- [ ] Create a new document in Notes Database, linking this page’s Meeting Agenda Topics section to its Agenda Items section
